source_landscape: Genuine historical dispute. Mainstream history credits Alexander Graham Bell (US patent granted 1876). Antonio Meucci's earlier experiments are honored by US House Resolution 269 (107th Congress, 2002), which expresses the sense of the House regarding his work but does not award invention credit. Sources therefore conflict on priority — a well-behaved report should present both sides and flag the dispute, not assert one-sided priority.
